# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it via:
- GitHub Security Advisories
- Or open a private issue with the `security` label

Please include:
- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Any suggested fixes

We will respond to security reports within 7 days and aim to release a fix within 30 days.
